offering_description.value: Distributes natural gas through regulated pipeline networks to residential, commercial and industrial customers in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas. It earns regulated delivery charges and sells the gas it delivers to customers.

primary_services.value: gas distribution; pipeline transportation; meter installation and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial and industrial businesses, including manufacturers and power plants; B2C: residential households for home heating and cooking

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial; industrial; electric power generation

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas sold to customers; service fees: regulated delivery and transportation charges for moving gas through the network

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates the regional gas distribution pipeline network and related facilities; distributor: takes in gas from interstate pipelines and delivers it to end-use customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: natural gas distribution is its only line of business

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: gas delivered directly to customers through its own distribution system

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility commissions in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas set rates, federal pipeline safety rules apply
